title: Team size, disqualification/suspension and operator policy inputs are not fully enforced by the product

original_titles.title: Team size 4-5 is published but never enforced by code
No operator surface to disqualify or suspend a team
No participant self-registration or team-join flow (fully organizer-driven)
Fine-grained admin roles (author, ground-truth, operator, content editor, super admin, integrity officer, auditor) not implemented
Manual score adjustment is admin-only while the matrix allows organizer for rescoring/finalization

problem: The product operates with organizer-managed teams and participants. The audit says the published 4-5 team size is not enforced, no team disqualification/suspension surface exists, self-registration/team join is absent, and fine-grained roles are not implemented. These are policy questions as well as code gaps.
impact: Organizers may create teams outside the published size/eligibility rules or lack a controlled process for suspension/disqualification. Adding self-registration or more roles without an owner decision could weaken the deliberate organizer-controlled registration model.

evidence_paths: backend/app/routers/admin.py: team create and participant registration
verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Obtain owner decisions for minimum/maximum team size, whether roster changes are allowed after start, and the disqualification/suspension policy.
Encode chosen limits at participant registration and roster mutation endpoints inside a transaction locking the team/event capacity row.
Add an audited team/user lifecycle state machine with reason, actor, timestamp, appeal/reinstatement policy and two-person approval for disqualification.
Keep public self-registration disabled unless the owner explicitly approves it; if approved, add invite/claim proof that does not reintroduce email-only takeover.
Add tests for team size boundaries, concurrent roster changes, locked roster, suspension effects on login/submission and audited reinstatement.

acceptance_criteria: Published team-size rules match backend enforcement.
Suspension/disqualification transitions are auditable, reversible only by approved policy and cannot be self-issued.
No ambiguous self-registration route exists without explicit owner approval.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
